source.full_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: repeatable base-colour/albedo surface texture for Captain LivÃ©'s pirate cabin in S0ulRebel/cruises. Match the already-inspected existing cabin, cartoon pirate Captain LivÃ©, painted wooden props, desk lantern and globe: rich but restrained warm colours, broad graphic brush shapes, simplified hand-painted cartoon adventure-game material. Not photorealism, not photographic scans. Make one flat, edge-to-edge SQUARE texture, target 2048x2048. Orthographic surface only, no room, no object, no frame, no text or labels. Neutral evenly lit base colour, no baked directional light, no lantern glow, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion vignette, no glossy highlights or bevel highlights, no relief-rendered deep grooves. This is texture colour, not a beauty render. SEAMLESS toroidal tiling in BOTH axes: motifs/grain/colours leaving the left edge continue at the right edge in exactly the same position and slope; top edge continues at bottom in the same way. No border, no margin, no fade at edges; edges are a continuation of the same material. Avoid distinct large knots or marks that draw attention to a repeat. Dense enough to read as material, simplified enough for fixed-camera 1080p gameplay. Material: FLOORBOARDS. Warm medium chestnut/aged honey-brown oak matching the cabin wood, slightly lighter and more worn than wall wood, low to moderate contrast. Eight parallel straight boards running horizontally from left to right, exactly equal height across the square, fine dark narrow butt joints staggered across rows, no long vertical grid lines. Half of a horizontal joint at top/bottom boundary so tiles extend with correct board spacing. Broad brushed flowing grain follows the horizontal planks, a few small understated oval knots, gentle scuff colour patches, no nails. Illustrate with clean large planar colour strokes like the existing cartoon wood crate; avoid high frequency scratch noise or photographic pores. Board ends and grain must wrap left-right. No rim lighting along planks, no perspective.

tiling.uv_rule: For a surface S_u by S_v metres, use UV extent (S_u / tile_span_u, S_v / tile_span_v). Sample with repeat enabled and mipmaps. Preserve density when the surface dimensions change; do not stretch a single tile to fit the room. Rotate UVs to align wood grain with the long direction of real pieces.

validation.repeat_preview: 2x2 simple repeats visually inspected; no image edge correction performed
validation.limits: Generated periodic colour is approximate, not pixel-identical at opposite edges. Small colour/grain transitions remain; live camera, mipmaps and material repeat must be inspected before calling the scene seam-free. 2048px was requested; native delivered size is1254px and is retained.

lighting.intent: Neutral base colour with painted grain variation; no directional scene light
